explanation: Processor pipelining improves instruction throughput by overlapping the execution of multiple instructions.  However, data dependencies between instructions can create hazards, limiting the performance gains.  A data dependency exists when one instruction requires the result of a previous instruction.  Understanding and mitigating these dependencies is crucial for maximizing pipeline efficiency and achieving optimal performance in computer systems.
